Name: Call of Earth
Evidence: The first of the Skyborne shamans' three Call of Earth steps on Zephras Isle. The game files it under the zone (16593), not under the Shaman heading, and no quest record carries a class. Windshaper Boro (251374) gives it, the shaman trainer that Embracing the Elements (92484, under the game's Shaman heading) sends shamans to, and its text asks the player to obey the call of the four elements and undertake a trial for each. The three steps are those of the dwarf shamans' Call of Earth (94373 to 94375, under the game's Shaman heading) and the Horde shamans' (1516 to 1521, shamans only in CMaNGOS): bring something to the trainer, drink the Earth Sapta at the spirit, bring the Rough Quartz back for a totem. QuestieDB's Forever corrections make 92466 to 92468 shaman quests, with no evidence given; Wowhead's Forever page shows no class, and no first-hand report was found. Not yet tried in the game: a Windshaper of another class at level 3 or 4 shouldn't be offered it. Approved by the user on 11 October 2026.

Name: Call of Earth
Evidence: The second step: find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta (6635, the item the quest hands over). It follows 92466, as the Horde shamans' 1517 and 1520 and the dwarf shamans' 94374 follow their first step, and the addon counts a prerequisite a character can't take as met, so it needs the class as well. Same evidence as 92466. Not yet tried in the game: a Windshaper of another class at level 3 or 4 shouldn't be offered it. Approved by the user on 11 October 2026.

Same evidence as 92466. Not yet tried in the game: a Windshaper of another class at level 3 or 4 shouldn't be offered it. Approved by the user on 11 October 2026.
